title: Morning Pitta Pocket
intro: A quick and easy breakfast pitta stuffed with eggs, cheese, and anything else left in the fridge. This time I had a couple of pittas from another meal, some leftover bacon bits and a handful of cherry tomatoes. Perfect for a lazy weekend morning or a grab-and-go breakfast.

steps.label: Chop and Mix
instructions: Grab the stuff from the fridge and chop it up if it isn't already.
Beat the eggs and get a pan on the heat.
Throw everything in the pan and cook until the eggs are set.
Season the mix with a decent helping of pepper, salt, chilli flakes, whatever is about.
Pop the pittas in the toaster, and when the egg is done stuff it in the bread.
